mk.satz.finanzen: Holds the purse and the ear of the markets; lose this person and you lose investor confidence.
mk.satz.inneres: Runs the police and the governors; knows more files than anyone else at the table.
mk.satz.aussen: Speaks for the country in foreign capitals, with contacts that are not always yours.
mk.satz.stab: Decides who gets to see you, which makes this office the real opponent for many.
mk.satz.justiz: Between the judicial council and the prosecutors: a tool or an obstacle, depending on what you ask.
mk.satz.generalstab: Commands the armed forces. Loyal as long as the officer corps trusts the government.
mk.satz.wirtschaft: Hands out subsidies and contracts, surrounded by businesspeople with wishes.
mk.satz.zentralbank: Independent on paper; the markets notice any interference at once.
mk.satz.opposition: Leads the largest opposition group and is waiting for your mistake.
mk.satz.partner: Holds the coalition together as long as it pays off for their own party.
mk.satz.kronprinz: The party sees the future in this person. The weaker your numbers, the louder the question of succession.
mk.satz.fraktionschef: Counts the votes in parliament. Keep the ranks closed and bills pass; let them slip and votes are missing.
mk.satz.journalist: Collects what leaks from the cabinet. The freer the press, the further this voice carries.
mk.satz.richter: Heads the Constitutional Court. An independent court costs you bills and earns you respect.
mk.stil.offen.zeile: Open competition: ambition grows, rivals fight in public, the press finds more.
mk.stil.gelenkt.zeile: Much is settled behind the scenes; whoever causes trouble is quietly cut down to size.
mk.stil.autoritaer.zeile: Fear keeps the ranks closed, but nobody tells you any more what will not work. Conspiracies grow in the dark.
mk.lage.offen: Your circle competes in the open; fear in the apparatus is low ({angst}).
mk.lage.gelenkt: The circle is managed: much goes through confidants, fear in the apparatus stands at {angst}.
mk.lage.autoritaer: The circle obeys out of fear ({angst}). Those who disagree prefer to stay silent.
mk.lage.nachfolge: The party is talking about your succession (pressure {druck}).
mk.lage.rivalen: {a} and {b} are fighting each other openly.
mk.geheimnis.doppelspiel: Playing a double game with your opponents
mk.geheimnis.auslandskontakt: Covert contacts with a foreign government
mk.geheimnis.putschzirkel: A circle of officers talking about a coup
mk.hebel.befoerdern.folge.amt: More responsibility and resources: loyalty rises, ambition is satisfied, rivals feel slighted.
mk.hebel.befoerdern.folge.neben: More weight in the party and the public eye: loyalty rises, rivals feel slighted.
mk.hebel.kaltstellen.folge.amt: Keep them in office but strip their power: resentment grows, the ministry works worse, rivals breathe easier.
mk.hebel.kaltstellen.folge.neben: Push them out of every committee: influence drops for a year, the resentment stays.
mk.hebel.kaltstellen.folge.richter: Put pressure on the court: less resistance, but judicial independence suffers and Europe protests.
mk.hebel.deal.folge.kronprinz: A year of calm in exchange for a promise for later: succession pressure drops sharply.
mk.hebel.deal.folge.opposition: A quiet agreement on one issue: less polarisation, your own people distrust the bargain.
mk.hebel.deal.folge.allg: A deal for one year: loyalty rises, resentment falls. Break it and nobody trusts your word.
mk.hebel.bauernopfer.folge.skandal: The person goes and takes the scandal along: trust returns, their camp is bitter.
mk.hebel.bauernopfer.folge.ohne: Without a scandal the dismissal looks arbitrary: everyone at the table wonders who is next.
mk.hebel.untersuchung.folge: The service checks contacts, accounts and connections; result in about {tage} days. It may leak.
mk.hebel.begnadigung.folge: Release: press freedom and standing in Europe rise, hardliners in the apparatus grumble.
mk.hebel.saeuberung.folge: Dismissals across the apparatus: a year safe from a coup, but fewer capable people, more fear, protests abroad.
mk.grund.kalt: Sidelined: a promotion would not be credible.
mk.grund.zentralbank: The central bank is independent; the economy file has its own levers for that.
mk.grund.dealLaeuft: A deal is already in place.
mk.grund.kommissarisch: Only acting in office: there is no one to sacrifice.
mk.grund.schonBekannt: You already know what there is to know.
mk.grund.saeuberungOffen: A purge cannot be pushed through in an open country.
mk.grund.unbekannt: This person is no longer part of the circle.
mk.grund.nichtMoeglich: That is not possible with this person.
mk.merke.bauernopfer: Was sacrificed to protect the president
mk.merke.wechsel: Went over to the other side
mk.log.befoerdern: {name} ({rolle}) is given more responsibility.{rivalen, plural, =0 {} one { One rival feels passed over.} other { # rivals feel passed over.}}
mk.log.kaltstellen: {name} ({rolle}) is sidelined: the title stays, the influence goes.
mk.log.deal.kronprinz: Deal with {name}: the succession question rests for a year.
mk.log.deal.opposition: Quiet agreement with {name} of the opposition.
mk.log.bauernopfer.skandal: {name} ({rolle}) has to go and takes the scandal along.
mk.log.bauernopfer.ohne: {name} ({rolle}) is sacrificed without any visible reason.
mk.log.untersuchung: The service is vetting {name} ({rolle}); result in about {tage} days.
mk.log.saeuberung: Purge in the apparatus, starting from {name} ({rolle}).
mk.log.wortbruch: The deal with {name} is broken; word gets around.
mk.log.fund: The vetting of {name} finds: {art}.{neu, plural, =0 {} one { Plus one previously unknown connection.} other { Plus # previously unknown connections.}}
mk.log.keinFund: The vetting of {name} finds nothing incriminating.{neu, plural, =0 {} one { One previously unknown connection comes to light.} other { # previously unknown connections come to light.}}
mk.log.gesickert: The vetting has leaked; {name} feels betrayed.
mk.warum.befoerdern: Those who are promoted bind themselves to you; those passed over notice.
mk.warum.kaltstellen: Sidelining saves the fight of a dismissal, but the resentment stays in the house.
mk.warum.deal: A deal buys time. Its value is your word: break it and nobody believes you again.
mk.warum.bauernopfer: A sacrifice can end a scandal; without one it only shows that nobody is safe.
mk.warum.untersuchung: The service sees what people hide. The better it is equipped, the faster and surer.
mk.warum.begnadigung: Mercy costs you with the hardliners and earns respect with everyone else.
mk.warum.saeuberung: Purges secure power for a while and cost competence, morale and reputation.
mk.warum.untersuchungEnde: What the service finds is leverage; what leaks is one more enemy.
mk.szene.befoerdern: {name} steps out of the cabinet room, visibly taller than before.
mk.szene.kaltstellen: The office of {name} has gone quiet: no more files, no more appointments.
mk.szene.deal: A handshake with {name} behind closed doors.
mk.szene.bauernopfer: {name} clears the desk while cameras wait at the gate.
mk.szene.untersuchung: An envelope from the service with the name {name} lies on your desk.
mk.szene.begnadigung: {name} walks out of prison to the cheers of colleagues at the gate.
mk.szene.saeuberung: Long lists, early mornings: the apparatus is purged, starting with {name}.
mk.szene.schlichten: {a} and {b} shake hands in front of you, both smiling thinly.
mk.szene.rivalen: {sieger} has won the power struggle; {verlierer} leaves the room without a word.
mk.szene.wechsel: {name} ({rolle}) turns up on the other side and talks about inside matters.
mk.szene.druck: A short conversation, a folder on the table: {name} understands.
mk.szene.designieren: You raise the hand of {name} before the party board: the successor is named.
mk.szene.hinhalten: {name} gets a promise for later and peace for now.
mk.szene.parteitagSieg: The party congress votes for you. {name} is the first to congratulate; the eyes say otherwise.
mk.szene.parteitagNiederlage: The congress follows {name}. You lead a party that wants someone else.
mk.szene.teilen: A joint podium with {name}: you lead, the party has its heir.
mk.szene.still: {name} is summoned to the capital and returns subdued.
mk.ev.rival.text1: {a} ({ra}) and {b} ({rb}) have been blocking each other for months. Now both let the press know who is to blame.
mk.ev.rival.text2: The cabinet is waiting to see whose side you take.
mk.ev.rival.warum: Rivalries grow where two ambitious people want the same thing. Deciding creates a loser; mediating costs capital; silence puts the feud in the papers.
mk.ev.rival.fuer_beschr: Costs 1 capital; {sieger} gains loyalty and resources, {verlierer} is deeply offended.
mk.ev.rival.schlichten: Call both in for a talk
mk.ev.rival.schlichten_beschr: Costs 3 capital; both lose resentment, the rivalry cools markedly.
mk.ev.rival.standard: The feud between {a} and {b} fills the papers; the government looks divided.
mk.ev.wechsel.titel: {name} is negotiating with the other side
mk.ev.wechsel.text1: The service reports meetings between {name} ({rolle}) and people from the opposition and the heir apparent's camp. Loyalty stands at {loy} out of 100.
mk.ev.wechsel.text2: Nothing is signed yet. A defection in the middle of the term would be an open break.
mk.ev.wechsel.textGeheimnis: You know something that could be dangerous for {name}: {art}.
mk.ev.wechsel.warum: Someone with nothing left to lose and a grudge looks for new friends. Keeping them costs; letting them go does too.
mk.ev.wechsel.deal_beschr: Costs 4 capital; loyalty +22, resentment −30, a deal for one year.
mk.ev.wechsel.deal_aus: {name} stays, with a deal in their pocket.
mk.ev.wechsel.druck_beschr: Costs 1 capital; the person stays out of fear: loyalty +28, but resentment +30 and more fear in the apparatus.
mk.ev.wechsel.gehen_beschr: Costs nothing; the person leaves with knowledge and a grudge, trust suffers, the heir apparent gains.
mk.ev.wechsel.gehen_aus: {name} defects; the opposition has a new voice with inside knowledge.
mk.ev.nachfolge.text1: In interviews {name} talks about the future of the party, not about you. Pressure in the party stands at {druck} out of 100.
mk.ev.nachfolge.text2.offen: In an open party this cannot be ordered away: answer, or the congress will.
mk.ev.nachfolge.text2.gelenkt: It can still be settled in back rooms; not for much longer.
mk.ev.nachfolge.text2.autoritaer: Nobody objects openly. But the talk in the corridors grows quieter, and that is not a good sign.
mk.ev.nachfolge.warum: Every long term produces heirs. Naming one makes you a caretaker; stalling costs; pushing them out makes an enemy.
mk.ev.nachfolge.designieren_beschr: Costs 2 capital; pressure drops sharply, but rivals are offended and your authority shrinks a little.
mk.ev.nachfolge.designieren_aus: {name} is the designated heir; the party has its answer.
mk.ev.nachfolge.hinhalten_beschr: Costs 3 capital; a year of calm, pressure drops noticeably.
mk.ev.nachfolge.ausbooten: Push them out of the committees
mk.ev.nachfolge.ausbooten_beschr: Costs 3 capital; eighteen months without influence, but the party sees that dissent is punished.
mk.ev.nachfolge.standard: You stay silent; {name} keeps talking, and more and more people listen.
mk.ev.parteitag.titel: Leadership challenge: {name} goes for the chair
mk.ev.parteitag.text1: {name} has gathered enough delegates to run against you (influence {einfluss} out of 100).
mk.ev.parteitag.text2: As things stand, your chance of winning the vote is about {chance}%.
mk.ev.parteitag.warum: An open party can vote out its leader. Poor numbers and a strong heir make that likely.
mk.ev.parteitag.kaempfen_beschr: Costs 4 capital; win and the question is settled for a long time, lose and you govern on weakened.
mk.ev.parteitag.sieg: The congress confirms you; {name} has to fall in line.
mk.ev.parteitag.niederlage: The congress follows {name}; you are number one only on paper, and the parliamentary group listens to others.
mk.ev.parteitag.teilen_beschr: Costs 2 capital; a dual leadership for two years, pressure drops, and so does your authority.
mk.ev.parteitag.teilen_aus: {name} becomes your equal partner in the party.
mk.ev.parteitag.standard: You do not show up; the congress elects {name} as chair, and you govern without backing in your own party.
mk.ev.enthuellung.text1: {journalist} has documents on {name} ({rolle}): {art}. Publication is imminent.
mk.ev.enthuellung.text2.offen: The press is free; this cannot be stopped, only answered.
mk.ev.enthuellung.text2.gelenkt: There are ways to slow the story down; none of them is clean.
mk.ev.enthuellung.text2.autoritaer: The apparatus offers to solve the problem. The question is at what price abroad.
mk.ev.enthuellung.warum: What breeds resentment in the cabinet ends up with the press. The freer it is, the further it carries.
mk.ev.enthuellung.opfern_beschr: Costs 1 capital; the person goes, trust partly returns.
mk.ev.enthuellung.dementieren_beschr: Costs 2 capital; the person is grateful, but the story runs and trust falls.
mk.ev.enthuellung.dementieren_aus: The government stands behind {name}; the papers print anyway.
mk.ev.enthuellung.interview_beschr: Costs 3 capital; the story waits, the press gets something else.
mk.ev.enthuellung.interview_aus: {journalist} gets the interview; the revelation stays in the drawer for now.
mk.ev.enthuellung.festnehmen: Open an investigation into the press
mk.ev.enthuellung.festnehmen_beschr: Costs 2 capital; the story does not run, but press freedom and standing in Europe drop markedly.
mk.ev.enthuellung.standard: The story about {name} runs without a response from the government.
mk.ev.putsch.titel: The service warns: a circle around {name}
mk.ev.putsch.text1: The report on {name} ({rolle}) names officers who have talked about a coup.
mk.ev.putsch.text2.offen: In an open order this is a case for the courts, not for lists.
mk.ev.putsch.text2.gelenkt: You can settle it quietly or send a signal.
mk.ev.putsch.text2.autoritaer: The apparatus is waiting for your word. It will be thorough.
mk.ev.putsch.warum: Conspiracies grow where fear rules and ambition has no outlet. React too harshly and you weaken your own army.
mk.ev.putsch.saeubern_beschr: Costs 4 capital; eighteen months safe from a coup, but lower morale and reputation.
mk.ev.putsch.saeubern_aus: {name} and the circle are removed; the apparatus is thorough.
mk.ev.putsch.still_beschr: Costs 2 capital; ambition drops, the person stays, and the officer corps sees restraint.
mk.ev.putsch.standard: The report is shelved; the circle around {name} grows bolder.
mk.ui.angst.hoch: High fear: the ranks hold, but the capable stay silent or leave.
mk.ui.angst.niedrig: Little fear: people contradict you, and you learn what will not work.
mk.ui.nachfolge.hoch: The party is looking for an heir. Answer before the congress does.
mk.ui.nachfolge.niedrig: Nobody is asking loudly about your succession right now.
mk.ui.disziplin.zeile: Votes the group leader adds to or costs every new bill.
mk.ui.stimmen: {n, plural, =0 {± 0 votes} one {{n, number} vote} other {{n, number} votes}}
mk.ui.verborgen: {n, plural, one {Only the service knows one connection.} other {Only the service knows # connections.}}
mk.ui.geheimnis.nichts: Nothing known. A vetting may change that.
